description: Provides various statistics about resources billed via given reservation.

operations.description: Provides various statistics about resources billed via given reservation.

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Weighted average of the data-reduction ratio for all associated pools
props.name: drrWeightedAverage

props.description: Extra capacity added when rounding up low-usage pools to 30TiB. In bytes
props.name: extraUsedCapacityLowUsageRounding

props.description: Extra capacity added because of low DRR storage pools; In bytes
props.name: extraUsedCapacityNonReducible

props.description: Extra capacity discounted due to plan forgiving some low-DRR usage. In bytes
props.name: extraUsedCapacityNonReduciblePlanDiscount

props.description: How many associated storage pools reported low data reduction ratio (DRR)
props.name: lowDrrPoolCount

props.description: Timestamp for the latest update of this billing status, in RFC 3339 format
props.name: timestamp

props.description: The sum of total used capacity for all pools with low DRR, if the DRR penalty applies. In bytes
props.name: totalNonReducibleReported

props.description: Total performance amount included in plan. In bytes per second
props.name: totalPerformanceIncludedPlan

props.description: Total performance amount reported at on-demand price. In MB per second
props.name: totalPerformanceOverage

props.description: The sum of all performance settings across the pools under this reservation. In MB per second
props.name: totalPerformanceReported

props.description: Total used capacity actually billed. In bytes
props.name: totalUsedCapacityBilled

props.description: Total used capacity included in plan. In bytes
props.name: totalUsedCapacityIncludedPlan

props.description: Total used capacity reported at on-demand price. In bytes
props.name: totalUsedCapacityOverage

props.description: Total used capacity as reported by associated storage pools. In bytes
props.name: totalUsedCapacityReported
